description: Returns the user's recent Suunto workouts ordered newest-first (Workout API v3). Each item: workoutKey (string id), activityId (numeric activity code — there is no separate plain-language 'sport' field; use get_workout_fit for the parsed FIT file's session.sport if a sport name is needed), startTime (epoch ms), totalTime (s), totalDistance (m), totalAscent (m), totalDescent (m), energyConsumption (kilocalories, not 'totalCalories'), hrdata: { avg, max } (workout heart rate — hrdata.max is the account's overall max HR, use hrdata.workoutMaxHR for this specific workout's peak). Auto-paginates with offset-based pagination until limit is reached or no more workouts exist. Each item also embeds SummaryExtension (including apps[]: the SuuntoPlus guide that ran, if any) and IntensityExtension (HR-zone times). Use get_workout_laps for the lap table of a single workout. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of workouts to return (1–1000). Defaults to 25. Pagination is automatic across API pages; set to 1 for the single most-recent workout.

since.description: ISO 8601 lower bound on startTime (inclusive). Filters on workout start time; omit for all time. Pagination is automatic so since does not affect page size.

until.description: ISO 8601 upper bound on startTime (inclusive). Omit to include workouts up to the present. Combine with since to target a specific window.

name: list_workouts
title: List workouts
